title: CPF Module Schema: Storage Account Module ReadMe
description: JSON schema for CPF module 'cpf-azure-prdsvc-storageaccount'. Use this to generate Terraform code that calls the CPF module.

access_tier.description: (Optional) The access tier for the storage account. The possible values are `Cool` and `Hot`.

account_kind.description: (Optional) The kind of account. The possible values are `BlobStorage`, `BlockBlobStorage`, `FileStorage`, `Storage` and `StorageV2`.

account_replication_type.description: (Optional) The type of replication to use for this storage account. The possible values are `LRS`, `GRS`, `RAGRS`, `ZRS`, `GZRS`, and `RAGZRS`.

account_tier.description: (Optional) The tier to be used for this storage account. The possible values are `Standard` and `Premium`.

app_id.description: (Required) A descriptive name (abbreviation) for the workload (application) as it is registered in Leanix. The identifier format in Leanix is 'APP-12345', for the purpose of naming resources only five numbers are used.

cmk_key_name.description: (optional) Key name to be used (max 127 chars)

cmk_rotation_policy.type: object({ notify_before_expiry = string time_before_expiry = string time_after_creation = optional(string, null) expire_after = string })
cmk_rotation_policy.description: (Optional) A rotation policy block as defined below object({ notify_before_expiry = "(Optional) Notify at a given duration before expiry as an ISO 8601 duration." time_before_expiry = "(Optional) Rotate automatically at a duration before expiry as an ISO 8601 duration." time_after_creation = "(Optional) Rotate automatically at a duration before expiry as an ISO 8601 duration." expire_after = "(Optional) Expire a Key Vault key after the given duration as an ISO 8601 duration." })

context.description: (Optional) The application context information for the resource(s) (maximum 10 characters).

create_role_assignment.description: (Optional) Whether to create a role assignment to the service identity to allow access to the key vault keys.

cross_tenant_replication_enabled.description: Specifies whether cross-tenant replication is enabled for the storage account.

custom_domain.description: (Optional) Map of the custom domain of the Storage Account. object({ name = "(Required) The Custom Domain Name to use for the Storage Account, which will be validated by Azure." use_subdomain = "(Optional) Should the Custom Domain Name be validated by using indirect CNAME validation?" })

customer_managed_key.type: object({ key_vault_id = string expiration_date = string identity_principal_id = string })
customer_managed_key.description: (Required) A customer_managed_key block as defined below object({ key_vault_id = "(Required) The resource ID of the Key Vault where the Key Vault Key resides." expiration_date = "(Required) Expiration UTC datetime (Y-m-d'T'H:M:S'Z')." identity_principal_id = "(Required) The principal ID of the User Assigned Identity that has access to the key." })

default_to_oauth_authentication.description: (Optional) Specifies whether to default to Azure Active Directory authorization in the Azure portal, when accessing the storage account. Defaults to `false`.

enable_file_share_AADDS_authentication.description: (Optional) Specifies whether to enable authentication to file shares via Active Directory Domain Services.

enable_key_access.description: (Optional) Specifies whether the key access is to be enabled. If it is set to `false`, any requests to the account that are authorized with the shared key, including the shared access signatures (SAS), are denied.

encryption_scopes.description: (Optional) The map of the encryption scopes in the storage account.

environment.description: (Required) The environment where the resource is deployed. It is provided as an abbreviation with maximum three characters to leave more characters to the other naming components.

https_traffic_only_enabled.description: (Optional) //to implement securtiy control, this property needs to be true to use techniques to establish an encrypted data channels over untrusted networks. However this needs to be false for file share because Azure Files doesn't currently support encryption-in-transit with the NFS protocol and relies instead on network-level security..

identity.description: (Required) An identity block as defined below type = "(Required) The type of managed service identity that must be configured on this storage account. The possible values are `UserAssigned` or `SystemAssigned, UserAssigned` (to enable both)." identity_ids = "(Required) A list of user-assigned managed identity IDs to be assigned to this storage account. This is required when `type` is set to `UserAssigned` or `SystemAssigned, UserAssigned`." })

instance.description: (Optional) The instance number, if the context includes or requires multiple resources of the same type (max three integers).

key_vault_id.description: (Required) The ID of the existing Key Vault to store the customer-managed key for encryption.

key_vault_tags.description: (Optional) Key Vault related tags to be set on key vault child resources.

kv_secret_expiration_date.description: (Required) The expiration UTC datetime (Y-m-d'T'H:M:S'Z') for the storage account access key from the Key Vault Secret.

large_file_share_enabled.description: (Optional) storage account is enabled for large file shares. Defaults to `true`.

location.description: (Required) The location of the resource group.

network_access_enabled.description: Enable or disable public network access for the storage account.

network_rules.type: object({ bypass = optional(list(string), ["AzureServices"]) ip_rules = optional(list(string), []) virtual_network_subnet_ids = optional(list(string), []) })
network_rules.description: (Optional) A network_rules block as defined below object({ bypass = "(Optional) Specifies whether traffic is bypassed for logging, metrics or Azure services. The possible values are any combination of `\"Logging\"`, `\"Metrics\"`, `\"AzureServices\"`, or `\"None\"`." ip_rules = "(Optional) One or more Public IP Addresses or CIDR blocks that must be able to access the storage account." virtual_network_subnet_ids = "(Optional) One or more Subnet IDs that must be able to access the storage account." })

nfsv3_enabled.description: (Optional) Specifies whether the NFSV3 protocol is enabled. Defaults to `true`.

org_id.description: (Required) A three letter code representing organization, tenant, or CSP.

persist_access_key.description: (Optional) Set this to `true` to store storage access key in the Key Vault.

resource_group_name.description: (Required) The name of the resource group the storage account is created in.

restore_policy.description: (Optional) The number of days for point in time restore. Must be less than the days specified in delete_retention_policy

retention_policy_days.description: (Optional) The number of days that the containers, blob, queues and share must be retained. The possible values must be between between 1 and 365.

static_website.description: (Optional) A static_website block supports the following: index_document = "(Optional) The webpage that Azure Storage serves for requests to the root of a website or any subfolder. For example, index.html. The value is case-sensitive." error_404_document = "(Optional) The absolute path to a custom webpage that must be used when a request is made that does not correspond to an existing file."

storage_policy_required.description: (Optional) Specifies whether the storage account management policy is required.

tags.description: (Optional) The tags to be set on each resource.

id.description: The ID of the storage account.

name.description: The name of the storage account.

primary_access_key.description: The primary access key of the storage account.

primary_connection_string.description: The storage account primary connection string.

resource.description: The name of the storage account resource.

agent_instructions.summary: To provision 'Storageaccount' via Terraform, call this CPF module with the inputs defined below. Required inputs have no default and must be provided.
agent_instructions.module_type_notes: This is a single-service CPF module. It provisions one Azure resource type.
agent_instructions.naming_convention: Resource names are auto-generated by the module using app_id, environment, and region.
